masteryZone.q: Which of the following describes the core role of a Tirthankara in Jain theology?
opts: A creator deity who governs the material universe.
A cosmic judge who rewards or punishes human souls based on karma.
A human teacher who has conquered sensory desires and guides others across the ocean of cycles of birth and death.
An avatar of a supreme deity sent to establish a kingdom of righteousness.
masteryZone.sol: Tirthankaras are not creator deities or cosmic judges. They are human beings who attained supreme liberation (Moksha) and showed others the way to cross the cycles of birth and death.

masteryZone.q: Rigveda makes references to all 24 Tirthankaras of Jainism.
opts: True
False
masteryZone.sol: False. Rigveda only mentions Rishabhadeva (1st) and Arishtanemi (22nd) by name. The remaining 22 Tirthankaras are not referenced in the Rigvedic texts.

masteryZone.q: The 23rd Tirthankara Parshvanatha was a prince of the city of _________.
opts: Varanasi
Ayodhya
Mithila
Vaishali
masteryZone.sol: Parshvanatha was the son of King Ashvasena of Varanasi (Kashi).

masteryZone.q:
Match the Tirthankaras with their emblems:
1. Rishabhanatha -> Bull
2. Neminatha -> Conch shell
3. Mallinatha -> Water Jar
4. Mahavira -> Lion
opts: All are correctly matched
Only 1 and 4 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct
None of the matches are correct
masteryZone.sol: Rishabhanatha has the Bull; Neminatha has the Conch; Mallinatha has the Water Jar; and Mahavira has the Lion. All of them are correctly matched.

masteryZone.q:
Assertion (A): Vardhamana Mahavira advocated complete nudity for monks.
Reason (R): Mahavira sought to establish absolute detachment (Aparigraha) from all physical possessions including clothes, unlike Parshvanatha who permitted a simple garment.
Select the correct option:
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct and R is the correct explanation of A. Nudity was the ultimate physical practice of Aparigraha.

masteryZone.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 19th Tirthankara Mallinatha:
1. According to Shvetambara, Mallinatha was a female princess.
2. According to Digambara, Mallinatha was a male monk.
Which of the statement(s) is/are correct?
opts: 1 only
2 only
Both 1 and 2
Neither 1 nor 2
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. This represents the primary gender status dispute of Mallinatha.

masteryZone.q: Why did Mahavira add the fifth vow of Brahmacharya (Chastity) to the four vows of Parshvanatha?
opts: To make the monastic discipline stricter and prevent the moral degeneration of the Sangha in a declining era (Avasarpini).
To oppose the Vedic traditions which did not advocate celibacy for priests.
To attract more female followers to the nun order.
Because King Chetaka requested him to enforce it.
masteryZone.sol: Mahavira added Brahmacharya to make the rules of self-control stricter, ensuring that monks remained focused and avoiding moral laxity during the Avasarpini era.

masteryZone.q: How does Jain universal history (Shalakapurushas) view the role of Tirthankaras?
opts: As rulers who conquered kingdoms and unified India.
As divine incarnations who fought demons and restored order.
As 24 spiritual teachers who periodicially revive the Jain Dharma when it deteriorates during cycles of time.
As writers who composed the Vedas and Upanishads.
masteryZone.sol: Tirthankaras are seen as spiritual leaders who periodically reform and teach the eternal Jain path whenever the cosmic dharma declines.
